messages.subject: Instructions to advise — Caspian v Harburn
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Harriet,

Instructions to advise on merits and quantum, and to settle the Particulars of Claim, attached under separate cover in the brief. Key questions: the SLA exclusive-remedy point, the strength of the repudiation case, and a realistic settlement bracket. Trial value c. £1.4m plus interest.

James Osei

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Instructions to advise — Caspian v Harburn
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Advice attached. In short: debt claim near-certain; repudiation good but turns on disclosure of Harburn's cost-reduction documents; their counterclaim is thin but gives leverage. Settlement bracket £950k–£1.15m net. I'd propose mediation after disclosure. I've also marked up the quantum to £760,950 on the revised 11% credit.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
